forecast.classification_reasoning: The question concerns macroeconomic indicators (US CPI year-over-year inflation) over annual horizons. While economic shocks can occur (which can introduce tail risk), standard inflation rates in developed economies without extreme crises are mean-reverting and cluster within established historical bands, making macroeconomic time-series forecasting predominantly thin-tailed when evaluated over multi-year horizons using standard econometric baselines and base rates.
